mapper.select: select template_id, template_name, standard, remark, del_flag from qms_audit_check_template where del_flag = '0' and template_name like concat('%', #{templateName}, '%') and standard = #{standard} order by template_id asc
select template_id, template_name, standard, remark, del_flag from qms_audit_check_template where template_id = #{templateId} and del_flag = '0'

select tmpl_item_id, template_id, clause_ref, check_content, sort_no, del_flag from qms_audit_check_template_item where template_id = #{templateId} and del_flag = '0' order by sort_no asc, tmpl_item_id asc

select check_id, audit_plan_id, clause_ref, check_content, check_result, evidence, sort_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qms_audit_check_item where audit_plan_id = #{auditPlanId} and del_flag = '0' order by sort_no asc, check_id asc

select check_id, audit_plan_id, clause_ref, check_content, check_result, evidence, sort_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qms_audit_check_item where check_id = #{checkId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into qms_audit_check_item(audit_plan_id, clause_ref, check_content, check_result, evidence, sort_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values(#{auditPlanId}, #{clauseRef}, #{checkContent}, #{checkResult}, #{evidence}, #{sortNo}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: update qms_audit_check_item set del_flag = '1' where audit_plan_id = #{auditPlanId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from qms_audit_check_item where audit_plan_id = #{auditPlanId} and del_flag = '0'
